title: Phrasal Verbs in Context
context: Phrasal verbs are everywhere in spoken English: 'put off', 'look into', 'turn down'. Learn each one inside a sentence, and notice where the object goes.
contextPersian: افعال عبارتی در انگلیسی گفتاری همه‌جا هستند: put off، look into، turn down. هر کدام را داخل یک جمله یاد بگیر و دقت کن مفعول کجا قرار می‌گیرد.

expressions.example: We need to come up with a better plan.
expressions.examplePersian: باید یک برنامهٔ بهتر ارائه کنیم.

expressions.example: We had to put off the meeting until Monday.
expressions.examplePersian: مجبور شدیم جلسه را تا دوشنبه عقب بیندازیم.

expressions.example: I'll look into the problem and call you back.
expressions.examplePersian: مشکل را بررسی می‌کنم و به شما زنگ می‌زنم.

expressions.example: She turned down the job because the salary was low.
expressions.examplePersian: او شغل را رد کرد چون حقوق کم بود.

expressions.example: They set up a new company last year.
expressions.examplePersian: آن‌ها سال گذشته یک شرکت جدید راه‌اندازی کردند.

expressions.example: I need to find out what time the train leaves.
expressions.examplePersian: باید بفهمم قطار ساعت چند حرکت می‌کند.

expressions.example: Can you sort out the problem with my account?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌توانید مشکل حسابم را حل کنید؟

expressions.example: Nobody wanted to bring up the budget.
expressions.examplePersian: کسی نمی‌خواست دربارهٔ بودجه حرف بزند.

expressions.example: I need to catch up on my emails.
If we do not hurry, we will fall behind schedule.
expressions.examplePersian: اگر عجله نکنیم از برنامه عقب می‌افتیم.

expressions.example: Don't give up. You're nearly there.

exercises.prompt: "The meeting was ___ until Monday." (moved to a later date)
She ___ the job because the salary was too low.
"I will ___ the problem and call you back." (investigate)

acceptedAnswers: come
exercises.explanationPersian: come up with یعنی به ذهن رساندن.

acceptedAnswers: out
exercises.explanationPersian: find out یعنی کشف کردن / فهمیدن.

acceptedAnswers: up

exercises.source: مجبور شدیم جلسه را تا دوشنبه عقب بیندازیم.
acceptedAnswers: We had to put off the meeting until Monday.
We had to put the meeting off until Monday.
We had to postpone the meeting until Monday.

exercises.source: مشکل را بررسی می‌کنم و به شما زنگ می‌زنم.
acceptedAnswers: I'll look into the problem and call you back.
I will look into the problem and call you back.
I'll look into the problem and I'll call you back.
I'll look into it and call you back.

exercises.source: او شغل را رد کرد چون حقوق کم بود.
acceptedAnswers: She turned down the job because the salary was low.
She turned the job down because the salary was low.
She turned down the job because the pay was low.
She turned down the job because the salary was too low.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: برای رد کردن turn down می‌گوییم، نه turn off.

exercises.prompt: "Sorry to bring up money, but we have to talk about the budget." What does the speaker want to do?
acceptedAnswers: Talk about money
Talk about the budget
To talk about the budget
Mention the budget
Discuss the budget
exercises.explanationPersian: bring up یعنی شروع به صحبت دربارهٔ چیزی.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I will look the problem into.
acceptedAnswers: I will look into the problem.
I'll look into the problem.

exercises.incorrectSentence: We have to find up what happened.
acceptedAnswers: We have to find out what happened.
exercises.explanationPersian: find out یعنی فهمیدن (اطلاعات)، نه find up.

speakingTask.instruction: Describe a problem at work and what you did using three phrasal verbs.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: مشکلی در محل کار را توصیف کن و بگو با سه فعل عبارتی چه کار کردی.
modelSentences: We had to put off the meeting until Monday.
I looked into the problem and found out the reason.
In the end, we came up with a better plan.

roleplay.aiRole: A friend interested in your work
roleplay.objective: Tell a short story about a work problem using phrasal verbs
roleplay.context: A friend asks what happened at work last week. Tell the story: what went wrong, what you found out, what you put off, and how you came up with a solution. Use phrasal verbs where natural.
roleplay.opening: You seemed stressed last week. What happened at work?
